scope: Stock public esc-configurator.com local-HEX flashing only; no hardware qualification or Compasless settings support
limits: Stock public site exposes no deployment commit; 82 source-map application files exactly match pinned upstream after newline normalization, and all ESC layout/version JSON data match.
Physical hardware and browser serial behavior are untested. The flash backend validates exact 4-way request/reply CRCs, erase/write semantics and verification.
Use local HEX with force disabled and migrate settings disabled, matching current target layout, MCU and PWM file.
Stock does not recognize Compasless by name. It displays BLHeli_S 0.4 except deadtime120, which displays UNKNOWN. Neither display blocks local reflash.
Stock layout208 settings UI is unsupported; use the dedicated Compasless configurator for settings.
Stock preserves installed compatible bootloader. Any bootloader bytes included in the HEX are not installed by the stock flashing path.
